messages:
maria_prod: Announcing GA for the Aurora hosted endpoints (aurora-small, aurora-l). Launch includes streaming v3, a new tool-calling multiplexer, and updated rate-limit defaults. Docs/migration: https://intranet.redwood/aurora-ga :tada:

ops-bot: deploy: hosted/aurora/ga -> succeeded 1769004321 :white_check_mark:

jon_engineering: Congrats! What's the rollout plan? Phased? immediate?

maria_prod: Phased. 5% canary for 2h, 30% for 4h, then 100% if no regressions. Fallback route = aurora-l-fallback (quantized).

tara_cs: Heads-up: CS will need a short migration FAQ and email to customers on Dedicated. Any SLA changes?

maria_prod: No SLA regressions. We added a per-route streaming concurrency default = 60; enterprise can request 120. We'll provide migration FAQ and example SDK diffs.

jon_engineering: Note for devs: streaming v3 changes multiplex framing. Update edge proxies to ingress v2.4+ or streams may be truncated.

patrick_sre: Canary watchlist created -> aurora-canary-watch (p99 latency, error-rate, token-cost, hallucination-score). I'll monitor dashboards during the 5% window.

kate_marketing: I'll prepare the announcement post and internal FAQ. Tara, want me to loop CS into the draft?

tara_cs: Yes please. Also pulling list of top Dedicated customers who requested low-latency instances.

maria_prod: Quick tester for multiplexing (devs):
REDWOOD_API_KEY=...
curl -N -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY" -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"aurora-l","streaming":"v3","multiplex":true,"tools":["search","math"]}' \
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/stream

jon_engineering: Also note: stop-sequence handling changed slightly vs older families. Run your prompt suite through eval harness if you rely on exact token boundaries.

maria_prod: Deprecation: realtime-v1 endpoints will be deprecated in 60 days; we'll auto-redirect with a shim for 30 days but please update SDKs. Deprecation notice in docs link above.

ops-bot: reminder scheduled -> deprecation-email goes out in 7 days to affected customers.
